scope: Pinned original descriptor generation only; csl/hardware are hooked, no pixel oracle. Candidate repeat_mask_v1 interpretation kept explicit.
candidate_sampling: P74=1 folds original src x/y into texture physical base, texture coords zero; dimensions differing with power-of-two source program size-1 mask. Equivalent candidate samples from folded base with dest-relative coords AND source-size-1. Same-axis dimensions program1fff but no coordinate exceeds that axis source size. Nonpower source axes adjust sprite size and are excluded.
